'''Blba Groves''' was a region located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==History==
The [[Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival]] was celebrated at the Blba Groves as a celebration for the hard work and sacrifices of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and animal handlers. Over the years, the festival grew to such popularity that visitors from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] travel to partake in the bountiful fruits of its citizens' labor.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|exp=lots|Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival}}</ref>

Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref> [[Alliance Commander]] visited Blba Groves and was approached by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] farmer named [[Ubog Ozo]]. The farmer asked the Commander to investigate a farm that had been plagued by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. In return, Ozo offered to give the farm to the Commander.<ref name="AnAgriculturalOpportunity" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blba Groves appears as a location for the Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival, an annual event first introduced in [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240529|text=The Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival Event has come to SWTOR!}}</ref>
